reply_text:
I answered Hollis in his thread in #central-team: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in the channel on Oct 14, and no later message changes it.

Before reading #central-team I checked that Hollis is a member. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed to share it with someone on the account's team.

The channel history shows my wrap-up note from Tobias's request got posted into #central-team as its own message (ts …0125). It's harmless, because it only repeats the seat count that was already there, but it's extra noise. I've left it in place.
